contract.name: MockGuildConsensusHost
contract.desc: Test-only Guild-shaped caller for independently exercising consensus policy bytecode.

methods.name: createConsensus
methods.desc: Create the real policy as this host's child and bind it back to this host.

methods.name: consensusActionMbr
methods.desc: Quote an opaque consensus action exactly as the Guild would.

methods.name: consensusAction
methods.desc: Forward an opaque consensus action with its quoted MBR exactly as the Guild would for `proposalID`.

methods.name: configureConsensus
methods.desc: Forward opaque draft configuration with its quoted MBR exactly as the Guild would.
